committed_source_adapter_contract: Next implementation: a read-only adapter obtains bound time and an exact irrigation carrier snapshot from kernel_committed_state_t, validates template/time/node identity, and derives both event and hydraulic view from that single snapshot before invoking the existing scheduled source composition. It returns tentative event/flux/forcing only, never publishes or changes the owner. An invalid owner exposes no actionable outputs; a valid snapshot with rejected request preserves its event candidate. source_binding_implementation: 3d16532f7 introduces src/adapter/mod_ppa_irrigation_source_binding.f90. It consumes previous physical forcing and successful SSDI process flux, copies unrelated forcing fields, replaces the SSDI rates and marks only a changed source or an existing event at the exact interval start. Expired marks are consumed; future/nonfinite marked times, invalid/split diagnostics, absent/mismatched/nonfinite/negative sources and contradictory inactive delivery are rejected without output. This helper binds water source rates only; it does not map solute, persist events, prove acceptance, or infer changes in other forcing fields. Caller supplies otherwise unchanged forcing and must manage other physical changes explicitly. The owner integration test uses this binding for source start/continuation/stop instead of hand-setting event flags.
